name: query_gp_clinic
description: Queries longitudinal patient checkup history and baseline blood test results from City General Practice (GP Clinic).

key.description: Lookup key. Use 'FIRSTNAME_LASTNAME' (e.g. 'JOHN_SMITH') to list a patient's annual checkup dates at their GP clinic, or 'FIRSTNAME_LASTNAME:DD-MM-YYYY' (e.g. 'JOHN_SMITH:09-03-2026') to retrieve the detailed lab panel and clinician notes for a specific checkup date.
